welcome.title: Welcome to Pilates at Home
welcome.subtitle: Your Pilates plan for home, no equipment needed, with or without a wall.

gender.title: What is your gender?
gender.subtitle: This helps with calorie estimates and exercise selection.

birthyear.title: What year were you born?
birthyear.subtitle: The app is for ages 16 and up.
birthyear.label: Birth year
birthyear.invalid: Please enter a valid birth year.

underage.title: Not yet
underage.text: The app can only be used from age 16. No data has been saved.

health.title: Important notice
health.text: This app does not replace medical advice. Talk to your doctor before training, especially if you have pain, health conditions or are pregnant. You train at your own responsibility.
health.confirm: I have read and understood this notice.

consent.title: Consent for health data
consent.text: For weight, height and BMI we process health data (Art. 9 GDPR). It stays on your device only. Consent is voluntary and can be withdrawn in settings at any time. Without consent you can keep using the app; calories will be estimated.

body.title: Your body data
body.subtitle: Optional. It stays on your device.

experience.title: How much Pilates experience do you have?
experience.regularHint: I have trained for a while

zones.title: Which areas do you want to train?
zones.subtitle: You can select several.

limits.title: Do you have any limitations?
limits.subtitle: We adapt the exercises. Without a selection, just continue.

pregnancy.title: Pregnancy
pregnancy.text: Please have your training checked by a doctor first. We only pick exercises marked as suitable. This does not replace medical advice.

schedule.title: When do you want to train?

preview.title: Your plan is ready
preview.subtitle: 30 days, tailored to you.
preview.forecastWeeks: At about 0.5 kg per week you reach your goal in approx. {{count}} weeks.
preview.forecastNone: Your target weight is not below your current weight. We focus on strength and mobility.
preview.forecastLow: The target weight is in the underweight range. Please talk to a doctor.
preview.noWeight: Without body data we show no weight forecast. Calories are estimated.

notifications.title: Enable reminders?
notifications.text: We remind you at your training time. You can change this in settings at any time.
